usage.off_detail: This backend is not recording usage. Totals and charts are hidden because zero would mean not recorded, not no traffic. Enabling collection records future requests only; earlier traffic is not backfilled.
usage.unknown_title: This backend does not report its collection status
usage.unknown_detail: The usage-statistics-enabled flag is unavailable. Collection cannot be verified, so totals and charts are hidden. Check backend versions in Management Center Info.
usage.coverage: Usage is stored in backend memory and resets on restart. Traffic while collection is off is not backfilled. The backend does not report the collection start time.
usage.empty_detail: Collection is on. No requests have been recorded yet. Send a request through the proxy, then refresh.
usage.no_cached_data: No previously verified usage snapshot is available. Retry to load usage.
usage.stale_error: Refresh failed. Showing the last verified snapshot.
usage.refreshing_cached: Refreshing. Values below are from the previous verified snapshot.
usage.age_stale: This snapshot is at least {{minutes}} minutes old. Refresh to check current counts.
usage.flag_failed: Could not check the collection flag.
usage.snapshot_failed: Could not load the usage snapshot.
usage.daily_evidence: Backend-reported daily totals. Missing dates are not backfilled. Hour-of-day totals are not dated history.
usage.no_dated_data: No dated totals reported. Daily points appear only when the backend supplies dates.
usage.model_evidence: Top 12 model/API pairs by requests. Latency uses retained request details only, not all-time samples.
